label: ECLYPSE S1000 connected controller
description: ECLYPSE building controller with 2 switched RJ45 Ethernet ports at 10/100 Mbps that can be configured individually for daisy-chain wiring, speaking BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP and REST. Up to three RS-485 ports carry BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU, and up to 20 I/O extension modules can be added.
